name: session-skills
description: Puts a session in its own git worktree and gets it back out again: adopt the worktree work is already in flight on or open a fresh one, and land the work by what the repo is rather than by a declared mode.

askBeforeOutwardWrites.title: Ask before a push or a GitHub or GitLab write
askBeforeOutwardWrites.description: Raise a permission prompt for a push that is forced or not known to be private, and for a write to the host with gh or glab. Turn it off on a machine with managed settings, where the prompt is skipped with a warning; hold pushes there with an auto mode rule instead.
